items.html:
A sound right-hand batsman and occasional medium pacer, Agha Zahid played in his lone test against the West Indies in 1974-75, scoring 14 and 1. He had a long and distinguished domestic first-class career scoring over 12,000 runs but could not make the Pakistan team again after his first Test appearance.
